scope: Engineering comparison; not a replacement PCB or a hardware acceptance record
constraints: Preserve local Thread border routing, active BLE, standard Ember Zigbee host compatibility, Z-Wave, CC1101, LD2450 and BME680
Use finished modules with male pins soldered into the carrier
No female module sockets, underside flying wires or new bare-component assembly
Keep the Ethernet jack accessible at the carrier edge

options.label: Compact S3, two SPI buses
options.tradeoff: Preserves current bus separation, but needs 24 accessible application pins in addition to service and power connections.

options.label: Compact S3, shared SPI
options.tradeoff: Shares clock, MOSI and MISO between W5500 and CC1101, with separate chip-select signals. Requires electrical and concurrent-load qualification.

options.label: H2 Ethernet intermediary
options.tradeoff: The 18-pin lower bound assumes Ethernet shares the existing H2 serial connection. A separate UART adds 2 to 4 host pins. W5500 and RJ45 remain present. Existing RCP firmware does not provide this network transport.

options.label: MG24 Ethernet intermediary
options.tradeoff: The 18-pin lower bound assumes Ethernet shares the existing Ember serial connection. Requires a new transport and preservation of the standard external Zigbee interface. W5500 and RJ45 remain present.

gpio_scope: Distinct host application GPIO only. Excludes supply, ground, native USB and boot/reset service signals. A lower bound is not a completed pin assignment.
intermediary_requirements: Carry the IPv6 and multicast traffic needed by the local Thread border router; a simple IPv4 TCP socket proxy is not equivalent
Implement framing, backpressure, bounded queues, scheduling and reconnection on both processors
Separate network startup from radio startup: the current S3 starts the Thread RCP only after Ethernet connects
Revalidate recovery and updates when restarting the radio processor also interrupts the network path
memory_note: The installed S3 has 8 MB PSRAM. Runtime capacity has not been measured. This is not evidence that every function requires 8 MB or that a 2 MB candidate cannot work.
